headline: Apple reportedly developing a smart camera that skips video recording
summary: Apple is reportedly developing a smart home security camera that uses AI to analyze activity and give text descriptions of events instead of recording video, as part of a rumored new Apple smart home ecosystem.

claims.statement: Apple is reportedly developing a smart home security camera that uses AI to describe events in text instead of recording video.

sources.quote: Apple’s reportedly developing a smart home camera that doesn’t record video
Apple is reportedly building a smart home camera that won't record video footage of you or anyone else
The device will apparently use AI to analyze activity in your home without actually filming it.

claims.statement: The camera is reportedly part of a new Apple smart home ecosystem.

sources.quote: Mark Gurman said in the first episode of the Power On podcast that the camera will be part of "a new Apple smart home ecosystem,"
